newsitem.title: USA: Trade expects light weekly U.S. wheat sales.
newsitem.headline: Trade expects light weekly U.S. wheat sales.

text.p: Traders and analysts said Thursday's USDA weekly export sales report should show a very light number for wheat, from 200,000 to 250,000 tonnes.
"I know the wheat sales number is going to be dismal," a trader said.
At 0730 CST Thursday USDA will release its weekly export sales data based on activity during the week ended November 28.
The market was expecting the corn tally from 500,000 to 700,000 tonnes, soybeans from 500,000 to 600,000 tonnes, soyoil from 10,000 to 20,000 and soymeal from 100,000 to 150,000 tonnes.
For the previous reporting period, the week ended November 21, U.S. wheat net export sales totaled 231,400 tonnes, corn 582,900, soybeans 754,200, soymeal 77,000 and soyoil 14,700 tonnes.
